spring.datasource.embedded-database-conn.default_desc: the most suitable embedded database that is available on the classpath

spring.datasource.name.default_desc: "testdb" when using an embedded database, otherwise null

spring.jdbc.template.query-timeout.default_desc: to use the JDBC driver's default configuration

spring.flyway.tablespace.default_desc: the default tablespace of the connection used by Flyway

spring.webflux.multipart.file-storage-di.default_desc: a directory named 'spring- multipart' created under the system temporary directory

server.jetty.threads.max-queue-capacity.default_desc: computed based on the threading configuration

server.servlet.encoding.force-request.default_desc: true when "force" has not been specified

server.tomcat.accesslog.locale.default_desc: the default locale of the Java process

server.undertow.threads.io.default_desc: derived from the number of available processors

server.undertow.threads.worker.default_desc: 8 times the number of I/O threads

management.metrics.export.influx.bucket.default_desc: the value of the db property if not set
